latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image to Video Offline (version 1.0.0):

- Convert JPG, PNG, WEBP, and HEIC images up to 200MB into 1080p MP4 videos via cloud GPU processing.
- Offline-capable workflow: No internet required during conversion; processing completes in 30–60 seconds.
- Guided session setup with free anonymous token support—100 credits valid for 7 days.
- Supports actions including upload, generate/edit (with keyword routing), export, and credits or state checks.
- Clear error handling and user feedback for upload limits, unsupported formats, and job tracking.
- Exports available as MP4 by default; also supports mov, avi, webm, mkv, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, and aac.
